summary.text: Theodore Schramm is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 136 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat John Bucy III.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father, fiscal conservative and stay-at-home dad.

paragraphs.text: Theodore Schramm won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 136 with no opposition.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed fighting corruption and cutting waste through forensic audits and tax caps, empowering parents in education, and securing communities and freedoms as his key messages.
He said he is passionate about fiscal accountability, education reform and community safety.
